chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q1 No Stimulus (7 points) — Set 2: migration & urban geography
chunks.content: AP Human Geography FRQ 1 (No Stimulus), 7 points, parts A–G, one each, escalating skill. Set 2 answer key by part: A [1] describe a type of voluntary migration; B [1] explain how migration may affect a city's economy; C [1] describe a type of housing discrimination in urban areas (e.g., redlining, blockbusting, restrictive covenants); D [1] explain how a city's infrastructure affects society; E [1] describe a challenge to urban sustainability; F [1] explain how urban design initiatives are intended to affect cities; G [1] explain why urban design initiatives may be criticized. Common failure: describe answers naming a term without characteristics; explain answers lacking a how/why mechanism; conflating forced with voluntary migration in A.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1A, 7/7
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 7/7 — earned all parts A–G across voluntary migration, migration's economic effect, housing discrimination, infrastructure and society, sustainability challenges, and the intent and criticism of urban design initiatives. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1B, 6/7
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 6/7 — earned six parts, missing one explain-level part (e.g., the criticism of urban design initiatives or an infrastructure/society explanation) where a how/why mechanism was incomplete. Illustrates a strong response one point short on a single explain task.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1C, 2/7
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 2/7 — earned only about two of the describe-level parts, losing the explain-level parts. Illustrates a low response that names terms but cannot explain urban/migration mechanisms.
